verdict.rationale: Canny documents an official JavaScript SDK for identifying users and embedding widgets on web and mobile, and its llms.txt references SDK installation. That is a real first-party SDK, but its scope is narrow (identify and widget embedding), and the evidence shows no general-purpose SDKs for building against the API. Missing for 10: official SDKs covering the full API across multiple languages, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
